description: Whether a station's report is near enough to a field with none of its own to say the field's weather by it, approximately: within 10 statute miles, the top of a METAR's vicinity (FAA-H-8083-28B 24.4.3.8.2, 'between 5–10 SM ... coded as in the vicinity (VC)'). A design choice: no FAA source says a station's flight category holds at another field.

distance_nm.description: The station's distance from the field, nm.

within_sm.description: How near is near, statute miles.
